biography: Mikko occupies a singularly fascinating position in the expansive chronicles of the Hector Trophée, bringing his refined golfing talents from the immaculate fairways of Kurk Golf to a single, carefully deliberated appearance in the esteemed pair competition. Away from the pristine links, this dedicated gentleman is known among his companions for an exceptionally sharp intellect and a penchant for intricate mechanical puzzles, often spending his evenings meticulously dismantling vintage wristwatches just to understand the harmonious interplay of their microscopic gears.

Within the grand context of the tournament, victories of the coveted Hector Trophée and the individual acclaim of the Victor Trophy have thus far eluded Mikko across his solitary tournament appearance. Nevertheless, his active participation in the vibrant community surrounding the event ensures that his compelling competitive journey remains fully open, leaving admirers in eager anticipation of his next masterclass on the course.
